# Events

Events and other top-level lines: what starts a trigger. 26 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Block break {#break}

```carve
on break
on block break
on mine
```

A block is broken. Has `player` (`<none>` when no player broke it). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on break:
    if player does not have permission "builder":
        cancel event
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Block place {#place}

```carve
on place
on block place
```

A player places a block. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on place:
    add 1 to {placed::%player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Chat {#chat}

```carve
on chat
on player chat
```

A player sends a chat message. Has `player` and `message`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on chat:
    if message is "help":
        send "Try /rules" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Click {#click}

```carve
on click
on (right click|rightclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
on (left click|leftclick) [with %item%] [on %item%]
```

A player clicks air or a block. `with` checks the held item, `on` the clicked block, in any order. Has `clicked block` (also `event-block`). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on right click with blaze rod:
    send "Whoosh!" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Command {#command}

```carve
command [/]<name> [<type>] [[<type>]]
```

Adds a script command. Entries: `permission:`, `description:` and the required `trigger:`. Argument types: `<text>`, `<number>`, `<player>`; `[ ]` makes one optional. New commands need a server restart.

```carve
command /greet <player> [<text>]:
    permission: greet
    trigger:
        send "%player% says hi!" to arg-1
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [commands](../commands.md)


## Damage {#damage}

```carve
on damage
on damage of player
on player damage
```

A player takes damage. Has `damage`, `attacker` (`<none>` for mobs and falls) and `victim`. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on damage:
    if damage > 10:
        cancel event
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Death {#death}

```carve
on death
on death of player
on player death
```

A player dies. Has `player` and `victim`; `attacker` is always `<none>` here. Cancelling stops Pumpkin's death handling but leaves 0 health.

```carve
on death of player:
    broadcast "%player% died"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Gamemode change {#gamemode_change}

```carve
on gamemode change [to %text%]
on game mode change
on player gamemode change
on player game mode change
```

A player's game mode changes. Has `old gamemode`, `new gamemode` and `player`. `to creative` filters by the new mode. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on gamemode change to creative:
    send "creative on" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Inventory click {#inventory_click}

```carve
on inventory click
on inventory clicking
on inventory click event
```

A player clicks a slot in an open inventory, any window. Has `clicked slot`, `clicked item` and `click type`. Cancel it so players cannot take menu items.

```carve
on inventory click:
    if clicked slot is 4:
        cancel event
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

```carve
on inventory close
```

## Load {#load}

```carve
on load
on script load
on server start
on skript load
```

Runs after scripts load, and after every successful `/carve reload`. No `player`. Cannot be cancelled.

```carve
on load:
    if {spawn} is not set:
        set {spawn} to location(0, 64, 0)
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Mob spawn {#mob_spawn}

```carve
on mob spawn [of %text%]
on spawn [of %text%]
on creature spawn
on entity spawn
```

A mob spawns. Has `event-entity`, `event-location` and `spawn reason`. `of zombie` filters by entity type. Can be cancelled.

```carve
on spawn of zombie:
    broadcast "a zombie spawned"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Options {#options}

```carve
options:
```

A block of named constants, used as `{@name}` anywhere in the same file.

```carve
options:
    prefix: &8[&6Shop&8]&r
on join:
    send "{@prefix} Welcome" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [functions](../syntax/functions.md)

## Periodic (every) {#every}

```carve
every %timespan%
```

Runs on a timer counted in server ticks from plugin load. No `player`. A `wait` inside does not delay the next round.

```carve
every 5 minutes:
    broadcast "&eDon't forget to vote!"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Projectile hit {#projectile_hit}

```carve
on projectile hit
on projectile land
```

A projectile hits something. Has `event-location` and `hit player` (`<none>` when it hit something else). Can be cancelled.

```carve
on projectile hit:
    strike lightning effect at event-location
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [events-items](../syntax/events-items.md)

## Quit {#quit}

```carve
on quit
on player quit
on leave
on disconnect
```

A player leaves. The player is already gone, so `%player%` works until the first `wait` but effects on them do nothing.

```carve
on quit:
    broadcast "%player% left the server"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)
